served.bankWhy: Paragraph 4 names the Hartig net as the lattice of flattened hyphae the fungus pushes between the outer root cells, and points out that it does the arbuscule's job by wrapping cells instead of entering them.

distractorNotes: Paragraph 5 does describe hyphae reaching out into soil, but the passage never gives that reach the name Hartig net.
That is the mantle, which paragraph 4 describes as a separate structure sitting on the outside of the root tip.
That is a vesicle, which paragraph 3 attributes to the arbuscular type rather than the ectomycorrhizal one.
That is the arbuscule from paragraph 3, and paragraph 4 opens by saying an ectomycorrhiza never enters a living cell.

answer.text: a lattice of flattened hyphae between the outer root cells
answer.line: Paragraph 4 names it: the fungus pushes a lattice of flattened hyphae between the outer root cells, and that lattice is the Hartig net.

steps: Find the name: "That lattice is the Hartig net." Paragraph 4, sentence 3.
Trace the word lattice back one sentence. Name, then trace back. Sentence 2 says it is flattened hyphae pushed between the outer root cells.
Keep the neighbors apart. The mantle is the sheath outside, the arbuscule grows inside a cell, vesicles store lipid.

choices.text: a lattice of flattened hyphae between the outer root cells
choices.note: Sentences 2 and 3: the lattice between the outer root cells is the Hartig net.

choices.text: a strand of hyphae running from a root tip out into open soil
choices.note: Hyphae reaching past the depleted shell into soil are paragraph 5. The passage never calls that reach the Hartig net.

choices.text: a dense fungal sheath covering the outside of a short root tip
choices.note: That is the mantle, named in the same sentence just before the lattice. Same sentence, other structure.

choices.text: a swollen hypha that stores lipid on behalf of the fungus
choices.note: Swollen lipid-storing hyphae are the vesicles of arbuscular fungi, paragraph 3.

choices.text: a branched fungal organ that grows inside a cortex cell
choices.note: A branched organ inside a cortex cell is the arbuscule, paragraph 3. Paragraph 4 opens by saying an ectomycorrhiza never enters a living cell.
